content: This paper presents a method for simultaneously selecting important longitudinal features and classifying categorical health outcomes using functional data, logistic loss, and functional principal components. The proposed adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm is computationally efficient for high-dimensional settings and is validated through simulations and a real-world study of chronic diseases and health/sociodemographic factors.
